decision.rationale: Reproducible derived-state defect: after add("basil") with cellsPerPacket=2, setPacketCount("basil", 3) updates selected to 3 packets but leaves occupiedCells at 2 instead of 6; remainingCells and overCapacity are consequently computed from a stale total. The supplied visible test does not observe totals at that point, so it remains falsely green. A subsequent add("marigold") and remove("basil") makes occupiedCells equal -1, further demonstrating the inconsistency.
